# Proficiency Scale

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:ProficiencyScale`](gmeow-ProficiencyScale.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/ProficiencyScale>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/expertise`](../../slices/expertise.md)

A framework for rating proficiency — language, skill, or any competency domain (CEFR, ILR, ACTFL, Dreyfus, NIH, assessed, self-reported). A value carried by [`gmeow:proficiencyScale`](../properties/gmeow-proficiencyScale.md), [`gmeow:skillProficiencyScale`](../properties/gmeow-skillProficiencyScale.md), and [`gmeow:levelScale`](../properties/gmeow-levelScale.md).

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gufo:QualityValue`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-qualityvalue)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:ProficiencyScale`](gmeow-ProficiencyScale.md) as a specialized kind of [`gufo:QualityValue`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-qualityvalue). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.
